title: Bottom-flux constitutive-error attribution sweep
motivation: F-AHL04A failed only the frozen bottom-flux gate. The adaptive candidate was closest, but still had 2.951951e-5 cm/day bottom-flux delta against the 1e-5 gate.
question: Which constitutive approximation component controls the remaining nonlinear Richards bottom-flux discrepancy: retention theta, capacity C, or conductivity K?
primary_observable: absolute bottom-flux delta versus analytical Richards
interpretation_rule: Attribute sensitivity only when tightening one error family produces a reproducible material reduction in bottom-flux discrepancy. Do not alter the F-AHL04A acceptance gate.
